name: Darayana Kamala
shortDescription: Large condominium of 841 apartments 150 m from Kamala Beach: 1 to 3 bedrooms from 30 sqm, from THB 5.46M. Sales launch 28 Nov 2026, completion Q2 2029.
description:
Darayana is a large condominium by The Title, the Phuket brand of Rhom Bho Property PLC, in north Kamala on Phuket's west coast, planned about 150 m from Kamala Beach and 40 m from Cafe del Mar. Brokers describe 841 apartments plus 7 retail units in low-rise buildings (nine buildings in one listing, eleven buildings A to K on a master plan in another) around lagoons and pools, with two car parks. Completion is planned for the second quarter of 2029, and the public sales launch is on 28 November 2026.
Apartments range from one-bedroom homes of about 30 sqm to three-bedroom residences of up to about 139.5 sqm, in eight types plus penthouses of 82 to 139 sqm. One-bedroom units are about 81% of the stock. Published starting prices (price list V.1 of 18 November 2026, buildings C, H and J) are THB 5.46 million for a 1BS, 5.86 million for a 1BM, 7.21 million for a 1BL, 8.37 million for a 1BP, 15.2 million for a 2BM, 19.7 million for a 2BL, 24.1 million for a 3BM and 23.5 million for a penthouse; 3BL units are on request. Final prices depend on floor, view and availability.
Planned facilities include the Caribbean Beach wave pool, a 25-metre lap pool, the Atlantic Lagoon hydrotherapy area, a rooftop pool with onsen, a rooftop fitness centre and Sky Pavilion, a yoga room, children's playrooms, an entertainment zone and a lobby with lounges. Buildings C and D are pet-friendly, with a dog garden. Ownership is listed as foreign freehold or leasehold; payment terms and the foreign-buyer structure are to be announced at launch. Distances are the developer's figures: Kamala Beach about 150 m, InterContinental 200 m, FantaSea 750 m, a hospital 1.5 km, supermarkets about 2 km, Patong about 15 minutes and the airport 35 to 40 minutes by car.

researchNotes: 2026-11-23: renamed from "The Nayabella Condominium" at the owner's request; all Nayabella/Nai Yang details (six floors, one-bedroom units, facilities, airport/Bang Tao distances, broker listing) were dropped because they could not be tied to Darayana. Only source found: developer page thetitleresidence.com/condominium/darayana/ (published 2026-10-27): name, Kamala, "New Project", tagline "Where the stars embrace the sea", price shown as a placeholder (X.XX). No other portal or news page lists the project. Exact site/address, units, sizes, facilities, price, ownership, payment plan and completion are not published; standard payment text is NOT verified. Image: developer teaser banner only (no project renders published). | 2026-11-26 re-check: developer page still shows only the teaser banner and a register form (no units, sizes, prices, completion or facilities); no FazWaz, Papaya or other portal page for Darayana found. Nothing further to add until the developer publishes details. | 2026-11-26 update from InAsia Consulting (broker site, not the developer): 841 apartments, 9 low-rise buildings of 5 and 7 storeys, ~20 rai, 1-3 bedrooms 30.10-139.50 sqm, foreign freehold / leasehold, pre-sale, sales launch 28 Nov 2026, completion Q2 2029, pet-friendly buildings C and D, 7 commercial units; 14 renders and the unit plan board downloaded from that page. Unit-plan sizes read from the board image. No price, bathrooms or distances published. Developer page itself still shows only the teaser. The unit counts and dates are broker figures, not confirmed by Rhom Bho. | 2026-11-26 prices and distances from Jungle House (broker site) citing developer price list V.1 of 18.11.2026 for buildings C, H, J: from THB 5,459,681 (1BS 140 units), 5,855,946 (1BM 348), 7,211,258 (1BL 88), 8,368,437 (1BP 114), 15,224,089 (2BM 72), 19,698,124 (2BL 35), 24,130,308 (3BM 12), penthouse 23,525,904 (14), 3BL (18) and retail (7) on request; 848 units in total = 841 apartments + 7 retail. Building count conflict: 9 (InAsia, Jungle House table) vs 11 buildings A-K (Jungle House master plan). Distances are developer figures. Prices are broker-published, not seen on the developer page; verify at launch.
